children: Citi launched its coverage of Nuvation Bio
with Buy ratings on Wednesday as part of a broader review of the U.S. biopharma sector, highlighting the companies' oncology products, Ibtrozi and Ziihera.
Analyst Geoff Meacham issued a $12 target on Nuvation

, noting that the tyrosine kinase inhibitor, which was approved in 2025 for a specific type of non-small cell lung cancer with so-called ROS1 mutations, “has quickly established itself as a leading ROS1 inhibitor.”

Pointing to a strong commercial rollout backed by potentially the best-in-class efficacy and safety profile, the analyst projected $1.1B in sales for Ibtrozi in the U.S. and cited "the most underappreciated component” in Nuvation’s narrative in its lead experimental drug, safusidenib.

“We believe investor focus remains centered on the Ibtrozi launch today, creating an opportunity for increasing recognition of the longer-term value embedded in the safusidenib program and broader pipeline,” Meacham added.
He issued a $325 per share target on Jazz
, underscoring the company’s oncology-led transformation and noting that Ziihera, developed with BeOne Medicines

“We think Ziihera has a credible path to becoming a leading first-line treatment for HER2-positive stomach and esophageal cancer, supported by its survival benefit over established treatment,” Meacham wrote.

The analyst projects the bispecific antibody to generate about $2.0B in sales in 2032, excluding opportunities in breast and other cancer types, while the company’s neuroscience portfolio provides “a durable cash-generating base.”

title: Nuvation, Jazz gain new Buys at Citi on oncology prospects
